title: The Heart, Blood and Circulatory Disease

flashcard_questions.q: A circulatory system in which blood passes through the heart twice on each complete circuit of the body — once to the lungs and once to the rest of the body.

flashcard_questions.a: The two lower chambers of the heart that pump blood out through arteries.
